description: Header file defining the 'Settings' class used for managing toolchain invocation settings in a build system, including configuration, output directories, and import management.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Represents configuration settings for a specific toolchain invocation within a build system, including output directories, import management, and target generation policies.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Constructor for initializing Settings with build settings and output subdirectory name.

methods.name: toolchain_label
methods.description: Returns the label identifying the toolchain.

methods.name: set_toolchain_label
methods.description: Sets the label for the toolchain.

methods.name: is_default
methods.description: Checks if this settings object corresponds to the default toolchain.

methods.name: toolchain_output_subdir
methods.description: Returns the output subdirectory for the toolchain.

methods.name: toolchain_output_dir
methods.description: Returns the full source directory path for the toolchain's output.

methods.name: toolchain_gen_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory for generated files.

methods.name: import_manager
methods.description: Provides access to the import manager caching imported files.

methods.name: set_greedy_target_generation
methods.description: Sets whether all targets should be generated regardless of dependencies.

methods.name: greedy_target_generation
methods.description: Checks if all targets are to be generated.

methods.name: ShouldShowToolchain
methods.description: Determines if the toolchain label should be shown for a list of labels.
